senses.definition: (architecture) A structural element resembling the hollow upper half of a sphere.
(by extension) Anything shaped like an upset bowl, often used as a cover.

quotes.text: The heatwave, caused by what meteorologists described as a dome of high pressure, extends from California up through areas in Canada’s Arctic territories and was worsened by the human-caused climate crisis.
quotes.reference: 2021 June 29, Gabrielle Canon, “Historic heatwave, extreme drought and wildfires plague North American west”, in The Guardian:

senses.definition: (obsolete, poetic) A building; a house; an edifice.

quotes.text: Approach the dome, the social banquet share.

senses.definition: (by extension) Any erection resembling the dome or cupola of a building, such as the upper part of a furnace, the vertical steam chamber on the top of a boiler, etc.
(crystallography) A prism formed by planes parallel to a lateral axis which meet above in a horizontal edge, like the roof of a house; also, one of the planes of such a form.
(geology) A geological feature consisting of symmetrical anticlines that intersect where each one reaches its apex.
(sewing) A press stud or snap fastener.
(transitive) To give a domed shape to.

quotes.text: The green and laughing world he sees, / Waters, and plains, and waving trees, / The skim of birds, and the blue-doming skies, […]
